domain_truths.name: planned vs available hours both shown
domain_truths.oracle: planned hours and available hours are both shown, and a plan exceeding capacity says so

domain_truths.name: a day states its shift boundary and timezone
domain_truths.oracle: a 'day' states its shift boundary and timezone - on a 3-shift plant a day is not midnight-to-midnight

domain_truths.name: wrench time vs total time distinguished
domain_truths.oracle: wrench time and total time are distinguished wherever both appear

domain_truths.name: a PM-sourced item carries the PM's due date
domain_truths.oracle: an item pulled from PM scope carries the PM's due date, not the date it was planned

domain_truths.name: completing updates the plan AND its source
domain_truths.oracle: completing a planned item updates the plan and its source (logbook / PM scope) - not one of the two

domain_truths.name: a carried-over item is visibly carried over
domain_truths.oracle: a carried-over item is visibly carried over, never silently re-dated - the difference between 'not done yet' and 'was never due until today'
